scripts.intent: Which skills and tools are registered
reply:
This is the harness session. A turn is answered here, on the local catalog model, unless a script already covers it.

What this session can do:
- Take a typed message as a turn and keep that session
- /sessions new starts a session, and /sessions lists or resumes one
- /sessions btw asks about the main thread, /sessions bg moves the active turn to the background, /sessions switch inspects a session, and /sessions fork starts one from an optional thread id and an optional message id
- /settings reads and writes daemon settings
- /tools lists the tools registered on this session
- /autopilot runs from the instructions you give it
- /help lists the commands

Registered skills are the ones loaded from the harness home. When any are loaded, they are named in the session instructions. Registered tools are the ones this session can call, and /tools lists them.

constraint.ebnf:
root ::= step{1,3}
step ::= expr " = " expr "\n"
expr ::= term (op term)*
term ::= number | ident | "(" expr ")"
op ::= " + " | " - " | " * " | " / "
number ::= "-"? [0-9]+ ("." [0-9]+)?
ident ::= [a-zA-Z] [a-zA-Z0-9]{0,12}
